I replied in #coastal-team: Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands on November 3, 2025. Moss's Coastal digest from Sunday 11/2 says ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Your own cutover recap from 12/8 gives the same date.

Your recap also says you kept running PHL day to day until Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told you to use Nov 3 for the official change, and Nov 22 if the tracker wants the date Kwame started running it.
